title: B2B Lead Finder & Email Enrichment

searchQueries.title: Batch search queries (agency / multi-city mode)
searchQueries.description: Use this field when the user wants to run multiple searches in one go — e.g. the same business type across multiple cities, or multiple industries in one location. Each entry is a full search query like 'dentists in Miami' or 'law firms in Chicago'. When provided, this takes priority over searchQuery. Examples: ['dentists in Miami', 'dentists in Orlando', 'dentists in Tampa']. Leave empty to use the single searchQuery field instead.

searchQuery.title: Business type / industry
searchQuery.description: Use this field when the user provides a business type, industry, or niche to search for. Examples: 'dentists', 'marketing agencies', 'SaaS companies', 'plumbers', 'law firms'. Do NOT use this field for a specific company name — this is for category-level searches that return many results.

location.title: Location (city, state, or country)
location.description: Use this field when the user specifies a geographic area such as a city, state, country, or region. Examples: 'Miami, FL', 'New York', 'London', 'Australia'. Leave empty to search globally or let Google Maps use IP geolocation. Do NOT put the business type here — use searchQuery for that.

maxResults.title: Maximum number of leads to return
maxResults.description: Maximum number of business leads to extract from Google Maps per query. Each lead is charged as a PPE event. Google Maps typically returns up to ~120 results per query before pagination stops. VibeLeads scope: qualify companies first. Optional contact extraction stays disabled in discovery; enable only a reviewed, relevant contact stage for named qualified businesses under the contact-use gate. Provider bounds are not recommended volumes or permission.

enableEnrichment.title: Enable email enrichment (crawl business websites)
enableEnrichment.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enableEnrichment.sectionDescription: When enabled, the actor crawls each business's website to find a real contact email. Enriched leads cost more but include verified emails scraped directly from the source.
enableEnrichment.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Proxy and performance settings. The defaults work well for most use cases.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
